name: Mary "Millie" Hawrysh

events.place: Beacon Hill Lodge, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada
Green Acres Funeral Home & Green Acres Cemetery, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes:
Mary, whom everyone called Millie, had 3 brothers, Peter, Alex and Mike, 2 sisters Nellie Futz (children, Ed, Bill and 1 daughter) and Ann Smakula. It is believed Mary died of Alzheimers disease. George and Millie lived for many years on Hindley Ave. in St. Vital, and the writer remembers many visits to their home with his parents Oscar and Julia Zelmer. She is buried at the Garden of Crucifixion, Section 22, Plot A (George is at Lot 2, Mary is at Lot 1).

They had no children.

-Allan Zelmer
